stops.note: the month of Mars and first month of the early Roman year, which is why September to December are named 'seventh' to 'tenth'
the Norman name replaced Old English Hreðmonað, which Bede (725) links to a goddess Hreða
'mad as a March hare', from hares' boxing in the breeding season, is recorded from the 1500s

current_meaning: the third month of the year
